actions.baseLevel: issuer.level+1 unless same enabled issuer then target.level+1

mixedGroups: old matrices/capabilities.csv is feature coverage, not final per-action threshold; this registry replaces its example numbers
ordinaryUi: native user identity uses same domain services but does not require an administrator key; legitimate Android/site constraints remain
highestRiskNativeUi: ordinary user UI shows destructive/owner prompts as required; valid admin request with applicable whitelist/owner grant is already explicit intent, no extra hidden UI veto
sourceException: source mismatch business lock is outside ordinary capability >= and cannot be bypassed by this registry
neverExposed: native main-process code loading as medium plugin
